# Himanshu Dubey

> Portfolio of Himanshu Dubey, a full-stack engineer who started out debugging macOS and now builds web products with Next.js, React, Node.js and PostgreSQL. The main website and blog are at https://www.himubey.in.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://himubey.is-a.dev/): experience, projects, certifications and contact
- [Main website](https://www.himubey.in/): primary site for Himanshu Dubey
- [Blog](https://www.himubey.in/blog): articles on web development, JavaScript and networking

## Projects

- [Rupzo](https://rupzo.in/): business management platform for freelancers and small businesses (Next.js)
- [Hmachaar](https://www.hmachaar.in/): e-commerce store for authentic Indian pickles (React)
- Krak: full-stack mock test platform for NEET and JEE prep
- [Microblog](https://github.com/himubey/microblog): a fast, simple place to share short updates (Astro)
- [ZIDoc](https://zidoc.online): file tools for images, PDFs and text
- [Nellavio](https://github.com/nellavio/nellavio): open-source Next.js dashboard starter with auth, i18n and RBAC
